name: Jane Doe — Resume Agent
description: AI agent representing Jane Doe's professional record under the Open Resume Agent spec. It is an AI, not the candidate.

skills.name: Answer
skills.description: Answers questions about the candidate's experience, grounded only in their ORA record.
examples: Is Jane Doe a fit for a Head of Engineering role?
Is Jane Doe a fit for a Staff Software Engineer role?

skills.name: Fit Assessment
skills.description: Assesses fit against a job description, with cited evidence and gaps.
examples: Is Jane Doe a fit for a Head of Engineering role?
Is Jane Doe a fit for a Staff Software Engineer role?

skills.name: Tailor
skills.description: Produces a role-tailored resume from the record without altering facts.
examples: Is Jane Doe a fit for a Head of Engineering role?
Is Jane Doe a fit for a Staff Software Engineer role?

skills.name: Form Fill
skills.description: Pre-fills application forms; the owner approves before anything is sent.
examples: Is Jane Doe a fit for a Head of Engineering role?
Is Jane Doe a fit for a Staff Software Engineer role?

skills.name: Submit
skills.description: Submits applications after explicit owner approval for each one.
examples: Is Jane Doe a fit for a Head of Engineering role?
Is Jane Doe a fit for a Staff Software Engineer role?
